bubbles.songTitle: Bullet Proof... I Wish I Was
bubbles.line: I could burst a million bubbles
stanza: So, pay me money and take a shot
Lead, fill the hole in me
I could burst a million bubbles
All surrogate

troubles.line: And he tells me all his troubles
stanza: Then he comes home
And he takes me in his loving arms
And he tells me all his troubles
And he tells me all my charms
Your tears, they tell me
There's really no way
Of ending your troubles
With things you can say

troubles.songTitle: That’s What I Want to Hear
troubles.line: Now don't tell me your troubles
stanza: Oh, you tell me that your last good dollar is gone
And you say that your pockets are bare
And you tell me that your clothes are tattered and torn
And nobody seems to care
Now don't tell me your troubles
No, I don't have the time to spare
But if you wanna get together and fight
Good buddy, that's what I wanna hear

troubles.line: The first proper song on the Silver Jews' first full-length album, Trains Acros…
stanza: The first proper song on the Silver Jews' first full-length album, Trains Acros…
On the line
And I can't stand to see you
I can't stand to see you
When you're crying at home
